chunks: "Whoever fulfills for Allah, Allah fulfills for him."

key_terms.رُوِيَ: it is narrated; indicating a reported transmission
key_terms.لَهُ: for him; in his favor or on his behalf
key_terms.لِلَّهِ: for Allah; done sincerely for Allah alone
key_terms.وَفَى: fulfilled faithfully; carried out with loyalty and completion

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith mean when it says whoever fulfills for Allah, Allah fulfills for him?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that sincerity and faithfulness toward Allah are met by Allah’s faithfulness and fulfillment toward the servant. It emphasizes reciprocal divine response to human loyalty, devotion, and steadfastness.
